rv.q: In McDonagh’s richly evocative writing, bleakness isn’t always endurable, never mind escapable.
“Don’t Miss” is a label applied to far too many productions, but in this case, it’s more than warranted.
Even against that backdrop, this “Beauty Queen” ranks as one of the highlights of the fall theater season.
To say this show is intense is an understatement and that intensity only builds swinging from laugh out loud humor to writhing discomfort.

cn.t: Theater UnCorked's production of McDonagh's dark classic earns strong praise, with critics highlighting its brilliant blend of dark humor and heartbreak in an impressive staging.
